node.title: N=256 local-norm cofactor collapse
node.statement: Local reciprocity gives R/2^mu=1 mod 256 for every nonzero integral norm R from Q_2(zeta_256), where mu=v_2(R). On the pair-feasible branch p=1 mod 256. Profile (3,4,0) has five possible cofactors and R=2^mu p. Profile (4,2,0) has 419 possible RowC cofactors; the exact prize field floor leaves eight, then the cyclotomic residue-degree rule excludes 1026=2*3^3*19. The seven live prize values are 2, 514, 1538, 4, 1028, 16, 256.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27, sharpened 2026-07-28: replaces broad cofactor intervals by exact local-norm congruence classes and reduces the leading prize S=18 profile from 419 cofactors to seven. It does not prove the remaining norm counts.
